title: kane-cli does not receive Attest's own model key or an unrelated secret from Attest's environment
gap: KaneBrowserRunner._execute starts kane-cli with no env=, so kane-cli inherits Attest's whole environment, including OPENAI_API_KEY (the compiler's key) and any other secret the caller exported. Scoping it needs a product hook that names the variables Kane needs (its own credentials, PATH, HOME); this repository does not record that list.
